knowledge_graph.title: Allergen immunotherapy
knowledge_graph.description: Allergen immunotherapy, also known as desensitization or hypo-sensitization, is a medical treatment for environmental allergies and asthma. Immunotherapy involves exposing people to increasing amounts of allergens in an attempt to change the immune system's response.

text_blocks.snippet: Pollen immunotherapy, also known as allergy shots or sublingual immunotherapy (SLIT), is a long-term treatment that aims to reduce pollen allergy symptoms by gradually exposing the body to increasing doses of pollen allergens. This process helps the immune system become less sensitive to the pollen, potentially leading to a reduction in allergy symptoms and a decreased need for allergy medications.
